Format: 300+ individual PNGs at 16x16, 32x32 and 48x48 (plus 3 full
  spritesheets), each icon with its own black outline already drawn.
Covers, directly relevant to STORY.md's treasure hunt: key_01a-e and
  key_02a-e (multiple key designs -- candidates for the 3 keys), gift_01a-f
  (a closed gift box) and giftopen_01a-f (a 6-frame box-opening animation --
  a strong direct match for "the box opens into the birthday card" beat).
  Also has potions, food, weapons, armor, tools etc. not needed by this game.
Does not cover: any 16x16 tile-grid ground tiles (this is icon-only, meant
  for inventory/UI display at STYLE_GUIDE's "Item icon 16x16, shown at 3x"
  size, which is exactly this pack's native resolution).
